content.short: Mercurial Finance is a stablecoin-focused automated market maker (AMM) on Solana.
content.description: Mercurial Finance is a stablecoin-focused automated market maker built for the Solana ecosystem. It pioneers dynamic vaults for stable assets, aiming to minimize slippage on swaps and to enhance liquidity provider profits through adaptive, dynamic fees and flexible capital allocation. The project also bundles a set of technical tools that empower users to easily deposit into these vaults and create stable assets, streamlining participation in stablecoin markets and improving capital efficiency for stablecoin liquidity and trading.
